summary: Many MPLS deployments use multipath techniques for high-bandwidth traffic, but MPLS-TP strongly discouraged them. This informational document looks at the use of multipath with MPLS and MPLS-TP and the degradation that can occur to some MPLS-TP functions.

eli5.summary: Splitting traffic over several parallel roads helps carry more, but it makes it harder to tell which road a package took. This explains the tradeoffs.
